info.title: The StartUp Legal – User & Marketing Mock API
info.description:
Complete mock API covering:
1. Public marketing (guest) flow
2. User registration & login
3. Authenticated SME dashboard — wizards, playbooks, profile, security, billing, subscription, payments, notifications, legal notices

Excludes: password reset, counsel portal, admin portal.
